profile.name: Jigar Bhinde
profile.title: Jigar Bhinde — Résumé
profile.description: Jigar Bhinde — Director, Data Analytics. Experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, audit intelligence, and team leadership.
profile.headline: Turning complex data into clear decisions.
profile.summary: Data analytics leader with experience across financial services, technology, hospitality, retail, and healthcare. Currently **Director, Data Analytics at Morgan Stanley**, building audit intelligence dashboards and scalable data pipelines, leading analysts, and translating complex data into actionable insights.
highlights: SQL & Python
Business intelligence
Analytics leadership

Led a team of **three analysts** in designing audit intelligence dashboards that identify high-risk areas across IT audits by analyzing vulnerabilities and risk domains, reducing manual effort by **30+ hours per month**.
Built and automated scalable data pipelines using SQL, Python, and Dataiku recipes, improved data quality, and ensured timely delivery across all stages of the Internal Audit lifecycle.

Supported end-to-end Key Business Services audits by developing a Continuous Monitoring Dashboard in Tableau that delivers real-time insights into operational risks, asset performance, and capacity breaches.

Built AI agents using Copilot to automatically scrape and ingest competitor vendor outage data into Hive tables, enhancing Vendor Performance, Benchmarking, & Backup (Transference) Tableau dashboards.

Launched a BI development lifecycle standardization initiative, including requirements gathering, data acquisition, dashboard design, UAT, and QC, resulting in consistency, reduced rework, and faster delivery.

Designed and executed an A/B test comparing the existing risk model (v1) with an enhanced model (v2) incorporating system criticality, breach likelihood, and audit history, reclassifying **17% of audits** into correct risk tiers and improving audit scoping and resource allocation.

Built GET APIs using Python to retrieve data from Vectr via a third-party gateway, integrating **over 100k records monthly** into a Hive table supporting Data Protection and Access Control dashboards.

Led the design and deployment phases of a MITRE ATT&CK framework dashboard in Aeolus (an internal, Tableau-like tool), capturing attack tactics/phases, techniques, and sub-techniques to support vulnerability and effort tracking for stakeholders from Red and Purple Teams, with row- and column-level security.
Enabled Purple and Red Teams to boost threat resilience by **over 10%** through improved visibility and control testing within simulated attack scenarios.
Engineered Adobe Analytics and Tableau dashboards to monitor Marriott website and Marriott Bonvoy app performance, driving a consistent increase in conversion rates from **4% to 6.9%**.

Used SQL (Snowflake) to construct purchase funnels and conduct customer email journey analysis, increasing personalization and leading to a **10% improvement in customer engagement** metrics and a **4% increase in revenue**.

Led a team of five who owned reporting solutions for Mobile Key, Web & App Check-ins, Kiosks, and Digital Upsell, leading to a **15% improvement in guest experience** and a **25% increase in product adoption**.
Developed an employee hierarchy and sales performance tracking system via a Tableau dashboard with robust row-level security protocols, resulting in a **20% increase in managerial efficiency**.

Spearheaded the automation of data cleansing, transformation, and integration procedures through an in-house tool, leading to a **30% reduction in manual errors** and a **10% boost in operational efficiency**.

Developed target demographic analysis for holiday marketing campaigns using SQL and Tableau, contributing to a **5% increase in profitability** and an **11% improvement in customer retention**; generated actionable insights on Revenue, Profit, Total Orders, and Average Order Value (AOV).

Developed performance comparison dashboards for retail products such as stick and robotic vacuum cleaners and refrigerators, enabling companies to benchmark their products against competitors; published on client websites and in magazines.
Expedited new hire onboarding by developing coursework, standardizing processes, and conducting training on client communication and SQL and Tableau best practices to improve team capabilities.
Won the **Annual Comradery Award** at Blend in 2023.

Developed Patient Behavior Tracking Tableau dashboards pulling data using Teradata SQL, driving adherence to medications and prescribers and adding **300k prescriptions** via SMS, IVR, and Point of Sale (POS) marketing strategies.

Identified test and control groups and established KPIs, including fill rate, pickup rate, and patient adherence; optimized A/B testing and campaign launch strategy, driving a **40% increase in prescriptions**.

Documented business requirements and used SQL and a Tableau dashboard to uncover quarterly trends for online legal copyright infringements and complaints, identifying factors influencing resolved and pending complaints. Recommended strategies to expedite the identification of flagged URLs, **saving 15% time**.
Identified recurring trends in causes, sub-causes, affected business services, and vendor outages using Tableau and SQL, enhancing proactive decision-making to meet **20% more SLAs**.
